block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_transmit: Broadcasts the redstone signal it receives. The higher it sits, the farther it reaches. Also relays nearby Remote Control presses.
block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_receiver: Outputs the strongest signal on its frequency.
block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_toggle_r: Flips on or off each time its frequency turns on, like a light switch. Outputs full strength while on.
block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_repeater: Picks up its frequency and broadcasts it again from its own height, to chain towers across long distances. Needs no redstone.
block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_converte: Picks up one frequency and broadcasts it on another, from its own height. Needs no redstone.
tooltip.reikos_signal_tower.converter_hi: Right-click it with an empty hand to set both frequencies. The tuner sets the one it listens on

block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_mast.too: Tower segment. Carries a redstone signal up to the transmitter on top.
